name: A Humble Offering
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Ishnu-alah, friend. Show me proof of the demise of a Lord of the Abyssal Council and I shall reward you with an item that should aid you in your battles against the Qiraji.
narrative.objectives: Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to bring her 1 Abyssal Scepter. You must also be Honored with the Cenarion Circle.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ande'thoras-ethil. It means; 'May your troubles be diminished,' in my native tongue.

Wear the band proudly and in good health, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Fandu-dath-belore? Oh, pardon me, adventurer. I did not recognize you. Have you the scepter?
